content:
The City of Laredo has brought its communications teams together under one roof, creating a new Communications and Marketing Department to handle how the city shares information with the public.

The new department combines Public Information and Community Engagement, Marketing, and Laredo TV and Multimedia Communications into a single team, the city announced Friday, November 6.

The city also named Felipe G. Romero III as the new Director of Communications and Marketing. Romero brings more than a decade of experience in public-sector communications and leadership to the role, according to the city.

City officials said the new structure is meant to strengthen collaboration and keep residents informed, engaged, and up to date on city operations, programs, services, and initiatives as Laredo continues to grow.

Sources: City of Laredo.
